global_falsifiers.conflict: Any conflicting evidence caps the earned level at E0_EXPOSED with verdict FALSIFIED until the conflict is resolved.
global_falsifiers.self_attestation: Any level whose required witness is the producer/applier themselves is unproven. A verifier that is the claimant is not a verifier.
global_falsifiers.staleness: Stale evidence cannot prove application, transfer, or retention; stale records cap at E1_UNDERSTANDS.

honest_labels.E2_CAN_DO: E2-proven: applied, outcome not yet independently verified
honest_labels.E3_INDEPENDENT: E3-proven: applied with independently verified outcome
honest_labels.E4_TRANSFER: E4-proven: transferred to a new task
honest_labels.E5_CAN_TEACH: E5-proven: taught to a cold successor

law: A learning level is not earned until a governed, observable runtime transition proves it. Schema capacity (E0-E7 fields) is not attainment. A claimed level above the computed earned level is REJECTED, never rounded up.

levels.description: The lesson was captured and persisted through the canonical Receiver path. Exposure only — nothing is proven about comprehension.
levels.downgrade_trigger: intelligent block tombstoned or retracted -> UNPROVEN
levels.falsifier: No intelligent block for the lesson on the canonical path -> level collapses to UNPROVEN.
levels.name: Exposed
levels.witness: the canonical Receiver (v7-smart-note-canonical); no human witness required

levels.description: Comprehension is proven by the one governed transition that exists on current main: paired control/treatment receipts with independent causal verification of what was understood.
levels.downgrade_trigger: verification retracted or receipt link broken -> E0
levels.falsifier: Verifier is the producer itself (self-attestation), or receipts do not resolve -> E1 unproven.
levels.name: Understands
levels.witness: an independent verifier distinct from the lesson producer

levels.description: The lesson was retrieved and applied to a real task by an agent. Application happened; nothing is yet proven about the outcome.
levels.downgrade_trigger: application receipt revoked or shown to reference a task that never ran -> E1
levels.falsifier: The application receipt cannot name a real task the applier acted on -> E2 unproven.
levels.name: Can do
levels.witness: the application receipt itself (retrieval -> application binding); instrument owner: convergence item D

levels.description: The application produced a measured outcome that an independent witness verified. Executor-owned observations are circular and do not count.
levels.downgrade_trigger: outcome measurement refuted by later evidence -> E2
levels.falsifier: Verifier is the applier, or measured_effect is absent -> E3 unproven (executor-owned observation is not verification).
levels.name: Independent outcome
levels.witness: an independent verifier distinct from the applier

levels.description: The lesson measurably improved a DIFFERENT task than the one it was first applied to, with independent verification. Anti-memorization: same-task repetition does not earn E4.
levels.downgrade_trigger: transfer shown to be the same task relabeled, or outcome fails on the new task -> E3
levels.falsifier: The only 'transfer' task is the original application task, or no independent verification -> E4 unproven.
levels.name: Transfers
levels.witness: an independent verifier distinct from the applier, on the held-out task

levels.description: A cold successor — an agent with no shared context with the lesson's producer — applied the lesson and achieved a verified outcome. The intelligence is portable, not just personal.
levels.downgrade_trigger: successor lineage shown to be warm (shared context) -> E4
levels.falsifier: The 'successor' shares identity or context with the producer/applier -> E5 unproven (not cold).
levels.name: Can teach
levels.witness: an independent verifier distinct from producer, applier, and successor

levels.description: The lesson survived time: it was re-retrieved and re-verified after a retention interval with no conflicts. Retention is re-proof, not a clock.
levels.downgrade_trigger: stale or conflicting evidence appears -> E5 (retention is the first casualty of staleness)
levels.falsifier: No revalidation receipt, or conflicts arose in the interval -> E6 unproven.
levels.name: Retained
levels.witness: the revalidation receipt (re-retrieval + re-verification); independent verifier on the re-check

levels.description: Compound proof: the full chain below holds AND at least two distinct independent witnesses have verified across it AND the lesson transferred in at least two distinct domains with zero conflicts in the mastery interval. Deliberately hard — E7 is a verdict, not a milestone.
levels.downgrade_trigger: any conflict or staleness -> highest level below E7 whose chain still holds
levels.falsifier: Fewer than two independent witnesses, fewer than two domains, any conflict, or staleness -> E7 unproven.
levels.name: Mastered
levels.witness: two or more independent verifiers, none of them the producer

ratified_basis: SN-0546 (LEARNED Is Not Mastered — every level needs a governed observable transition); SN-0340 (scorecard receipt gate); SN-0500 (think before you act)
